summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various enhancements, including efficient column updates and the introduction of a first-class Tag concept in the REST Catalog. Additionally, proposals for finer-grained access policies and linking schema IDs to data files have been put forward to improve functionality and compliance.
highlights: Proposal for monotonic snapshot timestamps in V4 tables
Discussion on adding checksums for durability in Iceberg
Proposal for recursive namespace listing in REST catalog
